 Unseen hero keeps Bahia on terms at Santos 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Ronaldo set the tone in the first minute with a sharp save, anchoring Bahia 's 1-1 draw at Santos . The goalkeeper's command of his box and reflexes repeatedly stalled the hosts' momentum.
 He was busy from the off as Alvinegro Praiano threw bodies forward, claiming crosses and smothering loose balls before the break to keep the visitors settled.
 OneFootball Videos
 After the restart, he foiled a close range effort with strong hands (47.). He then blocked a low strike that skidded through traffic (51.). Moments later, he dived left to parry again and preserve Esquadrão de Aço's advantage (54.).
 Ronaldo finished with 10 saves, eight of them from inside the box, as Peixe produced 11 shots on target from 23 attempts. The volume underlined how his positioning and handling absorbed pressure when the lines were stretched.
 Late on he tipped a skidding drive round the post (85.). In the third minute of second half stoppage time, he produced another stop amid a scramble, his reactions exemplifying a display that kept Tricolor Baiano alive to the final whistle.
 Bahia remain seventh in the Brasileirão and host São Paulo next. Peixe welcome Palmeiras.
